## Verdict

The Stop 1 `refutation-target` (comment 5750537855) is not refuted.

Live check at pin `0a97e9f6b5d2ce3d1737f4f6363302d34352d64e` (`isSourceFile` / `isTestFile` / `expectedTestBasenames` / `expectedTestPaths` / `evaluateForwardCoverage` staged):

- `isSourceFile("src/app.js")` false; `isSourceFile("src/untested.js")` false; `isSourceFile("src/foo.ts")` true
- `isTestFile("src/app.test.js")` false; `isTestFile("src/app.spec.js")` false
- `expectedTestBasenames("src/app.js")` empty array; `expectedTestPaths("src/app.js")` empty array
- staged `src/app.js` plus `src/untested.js`: exit 0, missing empty, first line `verify_forward_coverage: 0 new source file(s) checked -- all have forward coverage (#1310 / #4009).`
- staged those JS files plus `src/foo.ts` with no tests: missing is only `src/foo.ts`
- staged `src/app.js` plus `src/app.test.js`: still 0 checked

`SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` in `packages/core/src/forward-coverage/correspondence.ts` is `.py` / `.go` / `.ts` / `.tsx`. `evaluateForwardCoverage` continues past `!isSourceFile` on both the existence loop and the diff-coverage map.

## Existing mechanisms

Do not invent a second JS list.

- The v1 correspondence triple is `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` plus `isTestFile` plus `expectedTestBasenames`. `expectedTestPaths` returns immediately when basenames are empty.
- `test-boundary` `DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_PATTERNS` already includes `**/*.test.js`, `**/*.spec.js`, `**/*.test.jsx`, `**/*.spec.jsx`. Forward-coverage reuses that policy for search roots, not for classification.
- `intent-constraint` `isProductionSourcePath` already treats `src/*.js` as production and `*.(test|spec).js` as tests.
- `content/languages/javascript.md` already requires `*.test.js` / `*.spec.js`.
- `--allow-list` is the generated-file hatch. `content/scm/git.md` already ignores `dist/`.
- `evaluate.ts` header and CHANGELOG #1310 document v1 as `*.py` / `*.go` / `*.ts` / `*.tsx`. That is maintainer prose, not the gate success line.
- #4543 title is placeholder tests. #4537 title is App Router false positives. Distinct from this set-membership hole.

## 1. Bound-remedy must pick one harvest

sharpens-framing

Evidence: Desired is an OR (put `.js` in the v1 set with `.test.js` / `.spec.js` correspondence, or name a v1 exclusion on the N/A line). The issue title is only `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS`. Adding `.js` to the set without `isTestFile` and `expectedTestBasenames` makes every new `.js` fail with empty `searched:` (`names.length === 0` then `expected.some` on an empty list is false) and would treat `src/app.test.js` as a source. The exclusion fork is also unmet: the live success line at `checked=0` claims all have forward coverage, which is the opposite of an N/A consumers can see.

Failure mode: implementers harvest the title, ship a one-line set edit, and either fail-close with an empty search list or leave `.test.js` unclassified. Or they add a comment next to `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` and UAT still reads a pass.

Disposition: Bound-remedy names exactly one of: (a) include `.js` in the correspondence triple (`SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` plus `isTestFile` plus `expectedTestBasenames`), reusing the JS names already on `DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_PATTERNS` and the intent-constraint test regex, plus fixtures `src/app.js` / `src/untested.js` exit 1 and colocated `.test.js` / `.spec.js` exit 0; or (b) keep `.js` out of v1 and change the `checked=0` success line so it names the v1 extensions instead of affirming coverage. Do not bind the OR.

Road-not-taken: keep v1 as the four extensions and treat the JavaScript language pack as prose-only. Steelman: CHANGELOG #1310 listed those four on purpose; `--allow-list` and `dist/` ignore already exist for emit. Flip: the language pack, test-boundary JS patterns, and intent-constraint already treat `.js` as production source, and the live success line affirms coverage for a tree the gate never inspected.

## 2. Tests do not lock the JS omission

sharpens-framing

Evidence: `evaluate.test.ts` classification cases cover `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.py` / `.go` and `docs/readme.md`. No `src/*.js` assertion. The live UAT shape is untested.

Failure mode: a later edit can change `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` without `isTestFile` / basenames and the suite stays green.

Disposition: whichever harvest is bound, add the UAT-shaped fixture (and, on the include path, the colocated `.test.js` pass).

## 3. Sibling JS extensions

footnote

`isSourceFile` is also false for `src/app.mjs`, `src/app.cjs`, and `src/app.jsx`. test-boundary already lists JSX test globs. This leftover UAT is `.js`. Do not grow harvest to a JS-family sweep unless the Bound-remedy says so. Diff-coverage uses the same `isSourceFile` filter; it does not independently catch JS.

The asserted `relieves: P1` cite is true of the include harvest. Bound-remedy puts `.js` in the correspondence triple, not the Desired OR, and does not add `.js` to `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` alone.

Evidence, re-run against the pin (`SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` / `isSourceFile` / `isTestFile` / `expectedTestBasenames` / `evaluateForwardCoverage` skip on `!isSourceFile`):

- `isSourceFile("src/app.js")` false; `isSourceFile("src/untested.js")` false; `isSourceFile("src/foo.ts")` true
- `isTestFile("src/app.test.js")` false; `isTestFile("src/app.spec.js")` false
- `expectedTestBasenames("src/app.js")` empty array, so `expectedTestPaths` returns immediately
- JS-only added files never increment `checked`; the success line still reads `0 new source file(s) checked -- all have forward coverage`

If `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` grew alone: `src/app.test.js` would become a source (`isTestFile` still false) and every new `.js` would fail with empty `searched:` (`names.length === 0`). Bind names `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` plus `isTestFile` plus `expectedTestBasenames` (`.test.js` / `.spec.js`). That is critic 5750592516 finding 1.

Existing mechanisms already hold the JS names. Do not invent a second list.

- `DEFAULT_TEST_FILE_PATTERNS` already includes `**/*.test.js` and `**/*.spec.js`
- intent-constraint `TEST_FILE` is `/\.(test|spec)\.(ts|js)$/i`; `isProductionSourcePath("src/ingest.js")` is true
- `content/languages/javascript.md` already requires `*.test.js` / `*.spec.js`
- `--allow-list` remains the generated-file hatch; `content/scm/git.md` already ignores `dist/`

## footnote — sibling JS extensions stay parked

`isSourceFile` is also false for `src/app.mjs`, `src/app.cjs`, and `src/app.jsx`. This leftover UAT is `.js`. Bound-remedy already says do not grow harvest to those unless a later leftover says so.

## footnote — evaluate.ts header still lists four extensions

The `evaluate.ts` header documents v1 as `*.py` / `*.go` / `*.ts` / `*.tsx`. That is maintainer prose next to the set, not a second harvest. Include updates `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` in `correspondence.ts`; the header is the same gate. Bound-remedy already names the set.

## footnote — tests at pin do not lock JS

`evaluate.test.ts` classification cases are `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.py` / `.go` and `docs/readme.md`. No `src/*.js`. Bound-remedy already fixtures staged `src/app.js` plus `src/untested.js` exit 1 and colocated `.test.js` / `.spec.js` exit 0.

## Verdict

No `blocks-the-design`. No harvest-changing `sharpens-framing`. P1 is leftover of #4814 P3: JS sources are invisible to the v1 correspondence set. Bound-remedy covers that set-membership hole with the triple and the UAT fixtures, and does not recut #4814 P1/P2. Distinct from #4543 and #4537. The parent's `relieves: P1` cite stands. Line-start cite is well-formed; no leftover mix.

What would flip this to `blocks-the-design`: Bound-remedy adding `.js` to the set alone, binding the Desired OR, or leaving `expectedTestBasenames` on the empty default.

What would restore harvest-changing `sharpens-framing`: growing harvest to `.mjs` / `.cjs` / `.jsx`, or switching to the N/A success-line fork.

Road not taken: keep v1 as the four extensions and change the `checked=0` success line so it names those extensions (critic 5750592516 fork b). Rejected — Stop 1 P1 is invisibility of JS sources; include is the harvest that puts them in the needs-coverage set. Language pack, test-boundary JS patterns, and intent-constraint already treat `.js` as production source.

metadata.issueBody:
leftover(#4814): add `.js` to `verify:forward-coverage` SOURCE_EXTENSIONS.

## Origin

#4814 UAT 0.119.5, Stop 1 P3, critic 5749875872 finding 5, Handoff 5749929572. Operator confirmed the leftover split as a live turn.

## Remainder

`packages/core/src/forward-coverage/correspondence.ts` `SOURCE_EXTENSIONS` is `.py` / `.go` / `.ts` / `.tsx`. A greenfield `src/*.js` tree (UAT `src/app.js`, staged `src/untested.js`) never enters the needs-coverage set, so the gate prints `0 new source file(s) checked` and exits 0. Distinct from #4543 (placeholder tests) and #4537 (App Router false positives). Distinct from #4814 P1/P2 (check composer and AcceptanceCriteria ranking).

## Desired

- Include `.js` (and the matching test correspondence: `.test.js` / `.spec.js`) in the v1 source set, or name a documented v1 exclusion that `src/*.js` consumers can see on the N/A line.
- Do not recut #4814 P1/P2.

Dispatch SHA 7011e07402257adcda6fa496fac079cd8aa54d42. `isSourceFile` / `isTestFile` / `expectedTestPaths`.
